MODEL / ARTWORK / ORDER

Make the comparison specific.

Project review checklist
Review areaWhat to agree
PP, PET, acrylic and other plasticsRead the recorded material for the model; compare shape, lid fit, serving use and the required appearance.
SiliconeReview the structure and target dimensions. Collapsible capacity and folded dimensions are customized for the project.
LED assembliesSeparate the vessel material from the lighting, power and cleaning requirements.
01

Request documents for the actual product

Identify the model, material, intended drink, use conditions and destination. Ask which documents apply to that scope. Certificate placeholder images are not certification or test evidence.

02

Approve the decorated product

A material name alone does not confirm decoration adhesion, cleaning performance or component fit. Agree a relevant sample and acceptance criteria for the selected construction.

BUYER QUESTIONS

Questions before an order.

What should I include in a custom drinkware enquiry?

Send a model or reference, intended use, estimated quantity, artwork, packing, destination and required arrival date. If a specification is undecided, describe the use so it can be reviewed with the model.

Are the reference images and specifications the final order?

Use the references to discuss the project. Confirm the final material, dimensions, components, artwork and sample in the written specification before production.

How is a quote request sent?

Submit the project details and artwork on the contact page. The receiving service confirms storage with an enquiry reference. Email forwarding is pending configuration in this preview; website receipt does not mean an email has been delivered.
